designNotes.accumulationContract: PBR accumulates un-premultiplied radiance and weight with the same coefficient; the material blend is identical to T7 (lerp before EnvironmentBRDF). HDRP accumulates premultiplied radiance.
designNotes.algorithmSelection: usedAlgorithm selects Approximation or PBRAccumulation; nine accumulate kernels cover world/screen speed and surface/hit/both motion sources. Disabling both motion sources falls back to Both instead of the HDRP #error path.
designNotes.algorithmSwitch: The last algorithm is stored per camera history; switching either way resets the PBR accumulation and bumps ssrPbrResetCount.
designNotes.worldSpeedRejection: The world-speed reconstruction is ported verbatim from HDRP. Its baseline saturates the normalized speed on a static camera, so the behavioral accept/reject test uses the screen-space kernels; the world kernels are verified by kernel selection and the hard rejection debug view.
designNotes.debugView: SsrAccumulationSpeed colorizes the rejection decision (hard red/green or smooth hue). SsrPbrParams is a diagnostic view of the constant buffer.
designNotes.deferredSmoothness: SSR runs before the GBuffer overwrites GBuffer2, so all paths read the 0.5 + 0.5 * smoothness encoding from the depth-normals prepass.
